title: A Horizon for the Orbit
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Paloma Joubert, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
